snippet.title: Tom Clancy's The Division: 10 Year Anniversary
snippet.description:
It’s been 10 years since Tom Clancy’s The Division was first released to the world. For the people working on it, it’s been an even longer journey that started with a small and confident team sharing the feeling that everything was possible. 
Join us as we revisit the inception of The Division what it took to evolve the game for The Division 2, and a look at the near future!
Happy Birthday, The Division! 

___________________________________________

Website: https://www.massive.se/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/UbiMassive
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ubisoftmassive
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Ubisoft.Massive


About Massive: 

Massive Entertainment is a AAA game development studio based in Malmö and Stockholm, and part of the Ubisoft family. With a team of over 700 professionals from more than 50 countries, we are united by our passion for bringing memorable games to life.
 
We lead the development of projects like Tom Clancy’s The Division 3 and continue to shape live titles such as Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora, Star Wars Outlaws, and Tom Clancy’s The Division 2. Our cutting-edge Snowdrop engine is at the heart of our innovation, powering these experiences and pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
